component.name: PGPony
component.summary: OpenPGP encryption, signing and key management

description.p: PGPony encrypts, decrypts, signs and verifies files, folders and messages with OpenPGP, and keeps a keyring of your own keys and your contacts' public keys, in software or on an OpenPGP smart card.

ul.li: Modern OpenPGP (RFC 9580 v6 keys) alongside classic v4 keys
Post-quantum keys: ML-KEM encryption and composite ML-DSA signatures (RFC 9980)
Hardware keys over PC/SC, including on-card key generation and moving keys to a card
An ssh-agent and a git commit-signing shim served from the keyring
Folder encryption, large files streamed with progress, and watch folders
Keyserver, WKD and VKS lookup, with an optional Tor or SOCKS5 proxy
Importing public keys and trust from an existing GnuPG keyring
A Stateless OpenPGP (SOP) command line for scripts and interoperability testing

description.p: Nothing leaves your computer by default: the features that use the network are off until you use them or turn them on, and there is no telemetry.

screenshot.caption: Your keys and your contacts' keys in one keyring
Encrypt, decrypt, sign and verify on one screen
